name: NIX S3
summary: A small acrobatic humanoid aimed at entertainment and light service work rather than research: whole-body motion control tuned for flying-kick backflips, side flips and rolls, on a 21-joint body under 20 kg. It runs a Linux/ROS stack for modular development, with a quick-release 331 Wh battery.
notable: Whole-body control demos including backflips and side flips

sources.title: Lumos Robotics — NIX S3 product page
